VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the setter is declared only in the MEMORY branch and compiled out when both macros are set, but it doesn't state that on the macro path the function is neither declared nor compiled. The "other configurations" phrasing is vague, and "compiled out" is not paired with "not declared".
